results.title: Articos MCP Skills: 19 AI User Research Skills
results.content:
MCP, the Model Context Protocol, is an open-source standard for connecting AI applications to external systems. Articos has tested the MCP on Claude (desktop and web), ChatGPT, and it should work with any MCP-compatible agent. It also runs alongside other connections such as Slack, Linear or Notion, so you can test a message in Articos and post the winner to a channel.

Skills load separately. In Claude, custom skills are uploaded as zip files in settings on the Pro, Max, Team and Enterprise plans with code execution turned on, and they apply to your own account only. They also don’t sync between claude.ai, the API and Claude Code, so upload once per surface. Anthropic advises installing skills only from sources you trust. [...] ### How accurate are Articos MCP skills compared with human research?

Articos reports 86% recall against expert-published research findings, measured across 46 studies and checked against Baymard Institute and Nielsen Norman Group work. The studies span e-commerce, SaaS, healthcare, fintech, consumer mobile, education, enterprise and cross-cultural research. The method is documented on our methodology page.

The other 14% is where a skill can miss a finding an expert team would catch. A study gives you strong evidence before you build, which covers most weekly decisions. If a wrong call would be expensive or hard to reverse, confirm it with real participants too.
